description: This is a unit test class for the DefaultConnectionPoolConfig class in the MongoDB persistence configuration package. It tests immutability, equality, default values, and config value retrieval behavior.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionPoolConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultConnectionPoolConfig, testing its immutability, equality, default configuration values, and config value retrieval.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the static Config object for tests by loading the 'pool-test' configuration.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DefaultConnectionPoolConfig instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the hashCode and equals methods of DefaultConnectionPoolConfig.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesWhenBaseConfigWasEmpty
methods.description: Checks that the config object returns default values when created with an empty configuration.

methods.name: underTestReturnsValuesOfBaseConfig
methods.description: Verifies that the config object correctly reads and returns values from a provided configuration.
